user.title: Heat pump
user.description: Link the heat pump entities: the form suggests the ones recognised by name. A device is created with the «State», «Temperature difference» and «Plant map» sensors: use the map in the card.

temperature.name: Temperatures
temperature.description: Flow and return are required: they draw the two pipes and give the temperature difference.

funzionamento.name: Operation
funzionamento.description: They move the drawing: water flow drives the pipes, compressor frequency spins the fan.

data_description.portata: Without a flow sensor the pipes move at a fixed speed while the compressor runs, and the card says so.
data_description.compressore: Decides between «running» and «idle»; without it, frequency or flow decide.

altro.name: Efficiency and alerts
altro.description: Optional: shown as boxes or as chips under the drawing.

entita_sparite.title: Values no longer published: {nome}
entita_sparite.description:
These configured slots point to entities that no longer exist: **{voci}**.

This happens when the gateway stops publishing a value the system cannot feed - for example a cloud-connected heat pump, which provides no frequency, no flow, no COP and no switches.

Nothing was changed automatically. Open the integration options and remove the slots you no longer need, or point them at another entity.
